parameters.content:
## Google Scholar Paper & Citation Search Scraper

**Actor:** [Google Scholar Paper & Citation Search Scraper](https://apify.com/dataspryva/google-scholar-paper-and-citation-search-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-scholar-paper-and-citation-search-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `queries` (array)
- `clusterIds` (array)
- `authorIds` (array)
- `maxItems` (integer)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `filter` (string)
- `articleType` (string)
- `newerThan` (integer)
- `olderThan` (integer)
- `author` (string)
- `publication` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `name` (Author)
- `authors` (Authors)
- `year` (Year)
- `publication` (Publication)
- `citations` (Citations)
- `documentType` (Type)
- `documentLink` (PDF/HTML)
- `link` (Link)
- `clusterId` (Cluster)
- `scholarUrl` (Scholar URL)

description: Google Scholar paper scraper: runs the Google Scholar Paper & Citation Search Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, name, authors, year, publication and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
